Browser dependencies vendored from the official npm packages:

- marked 18.0.14: `lib/marked.esm.js`, MIT license in `marked-LICENSE`.
- DOMPurify 3.4.16: `dist/purify.es.mjs`, license in `dompurify-LICENSE`.

These are served locally; app startup does not depend on npm or a CDN.

Lucide Static 1.49.0: selected official SVGs in `lucide.svg`; ISC license and Feather notices in `lucide-LICENSE`. Package source, integrity and icon list in `lucide-version.json`. https://lucide.dev/
